game_engine_instructions: Paths are relative to the bundle root unless prefixed by bundle_assets_root. When generating Godot 4 code, import textures under res:// and map paths accordingly (or ResourceLoader.load after import). interaction_graph defines cross-space behavior; do not infer links only from space layout. spaces[].assets.animation may be null — skip AnimationPlayer setup when absent. Perimeter rects below match the default new-board catalog (1920×1080 damnation-style skeleton): pipeline/boardfactory/boards.py:default_catalog_dict, same math as app/domains/spaces/geometry.py:resolve_position and app/frontend/views/board_svg.py. docs/spec_prose.md explains the grid; edited boards may differ — real export must read that board's catalog from DB.
